status: registered: approved by the product owner on 2026-11-04 before any run; the code is commit eab270e
title: Group-background correction of the Naive Bayes member: a combiner refitted with the corrected member, gated on fresh fold seeds, CTI-HAL and Elastic
parent: docs 21.3.33 (profile-size bias, development only). The Naive Bayes member favours long ATT&CK technique lists on long reports; Kimsuky, with 130 techniques, led 18 of the member's 58 misses on the 68 development reports. The correction z-scores the member within each case, then each group against its own scores on the design folds.
request: the product owner chose the size bias as the first fix (2026-11-04) and asked that nothing interfere with the other session's work

rollback.settings: NAIVE_BAYES_BACKGROUND_ENABLED=false with the current ATTRIBUTION_COMBINER_PATH (attribution_combiner_procedure_core.json), CONFIDENCE_LABELS_PATH (confidence_labels_procedure_core.json) and ATTRIBUTION_HYPOTHESIS_MIN_PROBABILITY=0.20
rollback.artifacts: new file names only; every current model file stays as it is; before an adoption rewrites the current baselines they are copied to data/audits/nb_background/before/

measured_before_registration.member_alone: 68 development reports (vendor 34, campaigns 21, advisories 13), each report's accepted techniques taken from its recorded run of the current defaults, strict ranks. Naive Bayes as shipped: top-1 10, top-5 29, MRR 0.298. Corrected: 23, 34, 0.415; 14 gained, 1 lost; paired bootstrap top-1 +0.19, 95% interval [+0.09, +0.29]. Kimsuky as wrong leader 18 -> 0. Tried and not chosen: a multinomial likelihood with Dirichlet smoothing (best 21/68), the other report sets as reference (21-22/68), and the same correction on IDF cosine (13 -> 10) and Jaccard (16 -> 11). Reproduced by scripts/fit_nb_background.py --evaluate.
measured_before_registration.engine: setting off: the member list and the combiner fingerprint are unchanged and the shipped combiner loads (active). Setting on: the member is wrapped under its own name and the shipped combiner refuses (pipeline fingerprint changed). Test suite 923 passed, 6 skipped.
measured_before_registration.diagnosis_disclosure: the problem was found in the recorded runs of the current defaults on the gate seeds 109/113/127, CTI-HAL, Elastic and both fresh sets, read as totals only (who led a miss and how long each group's technique list is). No parameter of the change was chosen on those sets. The fold seeds of this gate have never run.

change.labels: confidence labels refitted on those design runs and pinned to the new combiner (display only, never a bar): data/models/calibration/confidence_labels_nb_background.json. If no set threshold meets its bound, they are fitted with --strong-only, as for the procedure core.
change.seeds: fold seeds 149, 151 and 157 are reserved for this gate in fit_attribution_combiner.EVALUATION_SEEDS; 131, 137 and 139 are reserved there too, for the knowledge-store registration of the other session

never: nothing is read from fold seeds 149/151/157, CTI-HAL or Elastic for this change before the gate. CTI-HAL and Elastic are never training lists. The knowledge store, its decisive set and its seeds 131/137/139 belong to other work and are not touched. The fresh head-to-head sets are left out of the gate (read as totals in the diagnosis).
compute: the GPU, the technique head service on port 8102 and about 8 GB of free memory are shared. The build and the gate start only when no other process holds the GPU and nothing listens on port 8102 (data/audits/nb_background/supervise.sh). The supervisor then starts its own head service on the pinned checkpoint and stops only that process at the end. One GPU job at a time.

gate.arms: off = the current defaults (rollback settings above); nb = the change; one run per arm on the same code
gate.sets: ATT&CK folds on seeds 149, 151 and 157 (never run); CTI-HAL anonymised headline (55 reports, names, 30 statements, --anonymize-actors); Elastic strict (8 labelled + 22 open set)
bars: 0 wrong names on every set of the nb arm (fold known rows, CTI-HAL, Elastic labelled; single and cluster names)
the Elastic open set names nothing in the nb arm
removed actors named on the fold unknown arms, pooled over the three seeds: nb <= off

fold top-1 pooled over the three seeds: nb >= off - 6. The folds keep the true group's technique list and favour the technique-id members by construction (docs 10.3, 21.3.33), so they guard the naming, not the ranking target.
correct fold names (single + cluster) pooled: nb >= 90% of off
CTI-HAL anonymised: nb top-1 >= off, nb MRR >= off, correct names >= off - 1
a gain on real reports: CTI-HAL anonymised top-1 nb > off, or CTI-HAL MRR nb >= off + 0.01, or Elastic strict top-1 nb > off
design seeds 41 and 53 with the chosen floor (in-sample for the floor): 0 wrong names
gate.adoption: if every bar holds and the product owner agrees, the defaults become the change: the setting true, the new combiner, its floor and its labels. The current baselines move to before/, and every *_current.json baseline is rerun on the new defaults. If any bar fails, nothing changes and the result is documented in docs 21.3.33.

secondary: the mechanism: on the misses of each set and arm, the median technique-list length of the wrong leader against the truth, and the misses led by the five longest lists (Kimsuky, Lazarus Group, APT41, FIN7, APT28)
the Naive Bayes member's own truth rank per set and arm (classifier_truth_ranks)
CTI-HAL at the tradecraft level and as reported; Elastic at the names and tradecraft levels; both arms (reported, not bars)
fold top-5 and MRR per seed, CTI-HAL top-3 and top-5, named counts, and the Naive Bayes columns' weight in the new combiner
shortlist recall: the actor inside the combiner's top-20 window, per set and arm
caveats: the gain is measured on the member alone. The combiner is dominated by the procedure-text members, which put the actor first on 52 of the 68 development reports, so the product gain may be small. The vendor, campaign and advisory sets chose the correction and are also the combiner's real training lists, so their cross-validated numbers are development numbers. The reference was built from the design seeds that also choose the floor (both development). The technique head's fold contamination (docs 21.3.18) is the same in both arms.
cost: laptop only, no API credit: fold lists about 1.5 h, real lists about 1 h, CV and fit about 1 h, design seeds about 40 min, gate about 2.5 h, secondary readings about 1.5 h, adoption baselines about 1.5 h
